- **"Do only the callback" is excluded.** The booking-condition sentence plus the records (no statement request dated 2026-09-22).
- **"Statement then callback, skip the upgrade" is excluded.** The hub's "fixed only after" sentence plus the 12-month Starter history, and separately the Starter yearly cap of 2 (two requests already in the rolling 12 months).
- **Candidate "pick a shorter period that Starter can serve" is excluded.** The period is "the date the customer chooses", and the customer's period starts 2025-03-01. The Starter yearly cap would block any period anyway.
- **Candidate "upgrade to Paloma Verified Plus" is excluded.** SSN/ITIN, proof of address and occupation are not logged ("KYC Documentation Matrix", "Desk Guidance… Entry requirements").
- **Candidate "preparation point 2 (long period) applies" is excluded.** Point 1 comes first, and the 2025-12-05 refunds_and_fees callback is inside 12 months.
- **Candidate "count the 2024-09-22 rejection" is excluded.** "on the same calendar day 24 months earlier … no longer counting".
- **Candidate "count the wallet credit / omit the in-transit bank payout" is excluded.** The 12-month window and "One payout is one payout entry in the ledger".
